recognize_zh: Perls 鐵染色高倍下，一個大細胞的胞質整片被染成深藍色、僅隱約見到偏心的細胞核，周圍粉紅色有核細胞不含鐵，代表這個類 Gaucher 細胞攝取大量鐵。
features: Single large cell with intense diffuse blue Prussian blue-positive cytoplasm
Eccentric, partially obscured round nucleus within the iron-laden cell
Surrounding nucleated marrow cells negative for iron with pink nuclear counterstain
Image is partly out of focus, limiting assessment of granule pattern and cytoplasmic texture
describe_en: Perls' Prussian blue stain of the bone marrow aspirate at higher power shows a single large cell with intense, diffuse blue cytoplasmic staining and an eccentric, partially obscured nucleus. The surrounding nucleated cells, which have pink counterstained nuclei, are iron negative, and no ring sideroblasts can be evaluated in this field. The image is somewhat out of focus, limiting assessment of granule pattern. In the context of AML with Gaucher-like cells, findings are consistent with an iron-laden pseudo-Gaucher macrophage.

ddx.vs: Ordinary storage macrophages contain coarse clumped iron granules without Gaucher-like fibrillar cytoplasm on the Giemsa-stained smear, so correlation with the Romanowsky stain is required.
Precipitate lies on top of the smear without cell boundaries, whereas here the staining is confined to the cytoplasm around a nucleus.
Ring sideroblasts are smaller erythroid precursors with discrete perinuclear granules forming a ring, not a large cell with diffuse cytoplasmic staining.
